fields.name: Consumer_Initiated_Calls
fields.fieldText:
Consumer Initiated Inbound Calls


Sales Pitch

  • Our Consumer Initiated Calls connect you directly with high intent consumers looking for insurance
  • They tend to convert at a higher rate than internet leads and can be great for team morale since it takes the work of cold calling consumers off their plate
  • We have made a lot of investment in improving our CICs over the last year and have seen some great results so this is a great time to sign up and take advantage of those improvements.
  • We use call duration as a way to judge quality since longer phone calls usually mean more meaningful consumer conversation. We’ve seen the percentage of calls that last longer than 10 minutes nearly double since this time last year with some of our larger agent customers having 50% of their calls going over that ten minute mark! With all the investment we’ve made recently, now is a great time to get started with Everquote calls.

fields.name: Lead_Connection_Service
fields.fieldText:
Lead Connection Service


What is Lead Connection Service?

With LCS you purchase data leads and our best-in-class outreach team calls them for you, transferring insurance shopper to you when they are ready for a quote.


How LCS Works

  • We make 7 dials over the first 7 days after the lead is delivered with the first call happening within the first minute (as long as the lead is delivered during your available call hours)
  • Transfer rates are around 7% on average
  • Agents should start their own outreach when they get a lead as well. LCS is a supplement to working leads, not a replacement.


LCS Value Prop

  • Agents using Lead Connection Service are seeing bind rate improvements between 20 to 30% on average compared to agents without LCS.
  • Lead Connection Service increases efficiency and saves time enabling agents to work up to 3x more leads compared to agents without LCS.
  • Lead Connection Service helps agents make the most of existing producers and reduces the need to hire additional staff.

fields.name: AGP
fields.fieldText:
Accelerated Growth Program (AGP)


Requirements to Join AGP

  • 2 or more producers
  • Minimum spend of $3500
  • Willing to provide disposition data to BC
  • Participates in intro call with BC
  • Willing to attend monthly reviews 
  • 90 day commitment
  • Open to taking enough geographic locations to get volume
  • You should push for 24 hour delivery to get volume


Value Prop for AGP

  • As a part of AGP, you will work directly with one of our best in class Business Consultants to do monthly business reviews to make sure you are getting the most out of our products and are hitting your ROI and growth goals.
  • Becoming an AGP customer also makes you eligible for our loyalty credit program. As an AGP customer, you get a loyalty credit for each month you meet the program requirements as a thank you for your business partnership. 
  • The Accelerated Growth Program also gets you exclusive, first access to new products and features. We have a ton of exciting new products and platform developments planned for this year and as an AGP customer you can be first in line to access these new products.

fields.name: Marketing_Services1
fields.fieldText:
Farmers Marketing Services


Sales Pitch and Value Prop

Now is a great time to join our Marketing Services program. This program is exclusively for Farmers agents and is eligible for cost-share


Our marketing services product helps to diversify your pipeline of prospects, grow your online presence and connect with online shoppers by managing your paid search through Google. All of your ad campaigns with us will be managed by a team of marketing experts.


We are currently running a promotion where you get a 50% discount on your cost per qualified lead until the end of September 2025. This will help you maximize your budget and allow us to send you more shoppers. 


With this promotion and a monthly ad spend of $5000, you can expect to receive 10 marketing services leads per day and about 300 marketing services leads per month. 


Early results show bind rates for marketing services leads are around 10%. That means if you are in the program with that example budget of $5000 a month, you can expect around 30 policies in a month, which breaks down to a bind per day. 


Along with the discount on bid costs, we are also updating the product based on customer feedback we’ve heard so far. We now are able to provide shopper date of birth and address information to you when you have a new interested shopper. There is still less information for a marketing services shopper compared to a traditional internet lead, however this update should help make sure you have all the information you need to prepare a quote in your system when you are following up with these shoppers.

  • Would you be interested in setting up an account with us so you can make the most of this promotion?

fields.name: EnhancedTargeting
fields.fieldText:
Enhanced Targeting- Project Doc

1-pager for Agents



  • I'm reaching out to share some exciting news about a new product feature we've just launched called enhanced targeting.
  • Enhanced Targeting allows you to specifically target the customer characteristics that are most important to your agency. Our initial offering will include the ability to target high intent traffic sources, consumers between the age of 25 and 65, small business owners, and in some cases multi-car shoppers. 
  • By connecting with shoppers who best meet your qualification criteria, we believe you'll see a significant improvement in the lifetime value of the leads you bind.
  • Furthermore, with enhanced targeting, you will only be charged the upsell price when the desired attributes are actually present in a lead. 
  • This product feature is currently only available for our AGP customers. If you join our AGP program today you will not only get access to this new feature, but will also get access to other AGP benefits. 
  • These benefits include working directly with one of our best in class Business Consultants to do monthly business reviews to make sure you are getting the most out of our products and are hitting your ROI and growth goals and you get a loyalty credit for each month you meet the program requirements as a thank you for your business partnership.

fields.name: SFMS
fields.fieldText:
State Farm Marketing Services Quick Hits:

  • ~10% Bind Rate
  • ~$120 CPB
  • Subscription fee waived through end of the year
  • ~$3500 budget = 30 policies/month


State Farm Marketing Services Pitch:


  • We are thrilled to invite you to participate in our Marketing Services pilot program!


  • Our Marketing Services combine some of the best parts of data leads and paid search digital marketing to deliver you high-intent shoppers who are specifically looking to speak with a State Farm agent.


  • Here is how it works- we place State Farm branded ads on your behalf, interested shoppers can click on the ads and then will go through a qualification process. If the shopper is a good fit for State Farm they will be directed to your website and you will receive their contact information via ECRM so you and your team can reach out. The best part- you will only pay for the leads where the shopper is qualified!


  • Some numbers to help understand how compelling our offering is right now. These are promotional details through the end of the year as we want to help drive as many policies to you as we can and get our offering out in the market:
    • Bind rates are around 10%+
    • Cost per qualified lead comes out to about $12 for this promotional period - far less than market rates
    • If you are in the program with a budget of $3500 a month, you can expect around 30 policies in a month, which breaks down to a bind per day with an estimated cost per bind of $120!

As part of the Unified Lead Generation pilot launch, we are also waiving the subscription fee for State Farm customers through the end of the year. Now is the time to join the pilot program, take advantage of the low pricing, and see how Everquote’s marketing service can help grow your business!
